selected_plan.angle: What the dated October Fed target range establishes, and what a policy-rate range cannot tell readers about the next move.
selected_plan.evidence_plan: Resolve the exact October 28 official statement and compare only relevant dated prior policy text through existing source owners. Verify retained range, decision language and publication timestamp; check the supplied September statement without assuming a change or hold from matching numbers. Preserve cutoff, source versions and public rights. Missing market expectations, current yields and market reaction prohibit surprise, pricing or causal claims. Code owns numeric comparison. Use exact source-bound document excerpts and let the MAX editor decide useful visuals; do not present the retained release as new.
selected_plan.selection_rationale: The most recent supplied official policy document directly matters to rates and cross-asset readers. A bounded distinction between documented policy and inference is independently useful without inventing market reaction.
